rules.statement: The settlement of 1930 between Bandara Menika and Somawathie, despite the uncertainty around proving adoption for inheritance purposes under Kandyan law at that time, was likely motivated by a desire to avoid protracted litigation rather than fraud or personal gain.
rules.supporting_quote: For then only can the plaintiff invoke the well-settled principle of law which, has been incorporated in Section 90 of the Trusts Ordinance in the following terms : "When a person bound in a fiduciary capacity to protect the interests of another person, by availing himself of his character, gains for himself any pecuniary advantage, .... he must hold for the benefit of such other person the advantage so gained."
